text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cesario had submitted a request to use the studio late at night,
so I went to check in on her...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I think it's coming together nicely.
Let's take a short break.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Phew. But still... I've got a whole mountain of choreography left to memorize~
choice_data_list: Thanks for working so late. Looks like the two of you were doing it together.
Thanks for working so late. Looks like the two of you were doing it together.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's Cesario's Trainer.
Thanks for your hard work!
Ehehe, she was helping me out while I stayed late♪

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Since Craft and I often enter the same races,
it's inevitable that we end up performing in the Winning Live together, too."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
It's better to be together so that when we dance to the same song,
it's easier to gauge our positions relative to each other.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"It also helps me organize my movements
in the side position."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
You're right!
That'll make it easier to get in the zone for the real thing♪

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Still, I've been doing the center choreography
this whole time, is that really okay?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: We don't know who's gonna be center for the real show, and we might do the same song in another race anyway.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"This is Craft's practice,
so you don't need to worry about me."
choice_data_list: Well, Cesario never misses a beat when it comes to that.
Still, Craft does have a point.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Right, right. Don't worry, I'll set aside separate time to practice the center position.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, I think Craft still has
room to refine her footwork a bit more.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Urk... I-I knew it?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Your moves at center stage can be much more relaxed and expansive.
It's a special privilege for the one who took 1st place, after all.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I want to show the fans who support me
the coolest, cutest,
and most breathtaking moment possible.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
1, 2, 3, 4, 1, 2, 3, 4...
Alright, keep your eyes up!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Cesario is...
sometimes just like a teacher...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Flattery will get you nowhere!
Alright, let's go for another take just like that!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Waaah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, the dance lesson continued late into the night
as she gave instructions for the center position while matching
her own movements to the side position.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly! We wanna see
Cesario show us how it's done too!
choice_data_list: Apparently that's how it is, Teach-er

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Geez.
Please stop teasing me, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Truth is, I want you to dance in the center

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Well, if that's the case...
I'll do the center's routine this time.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Fufu~♪
Cesario's footwork really is so cool!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Where on earth did you get that...?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
All right! Then I'll match along
from the side position this time♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, the two of them synced their rhythms, staying late
to perfect their dance routine.
